# Connect, record, replace, and scale across every system

Wexpro Labs helps operations teams connect to browser portals, desktop applications, Citrix environments, and private APIs, then turn one demonstrated process into a reusable workflow that can run at scale.

## Direct answer

A user performs one real recurring workflow across every system it touches. Wexpro records the browser, desktop, Citrix, file, and API handoffs in one trace, converts stable steps into reusable execution, and keeps agentic computer use for variation. A human approval checkpoint can be placed anywhere—or nowhere. Approved workflows can start from the UI, a schedule, or an API event, run in parallel, leave evidence, and return exceptions with context.

## The business problem

The same process must be performed again for every request, order, report, customer, or account change. Operators become the integration layer between systems that do not talk to one another. Important checks live in their heads, rigid macros break when inputs vary, and more volume becomes longer queues and more staffing pressure.

## The solution

1. Connect: use the integration surface the system supports—browser, desktop, Citrix, or a reverse-engineered private API.
2. Record and replace: record one real end-to-end workflow, add a human approval checkpoint wherever judgment belongs, and replace the repeatable path with approved execution.
3. Scale: keep sessions authenticated, run thousands of workflows in parallel, optimize stable steps into deterministic routes, and retain computer use when a system changes.

## Why it is not a click recorder

A click recorder memorizes coordinates and one fixed path. Wexpro learns an outcome-level workflow from the demonstrated process. Each approved step can use a public or private API where one is available and browser, desktop, or Citrix computer use where it is not. The workflow preserves checks and expected results as inputs change, stops when it cannot confirm the intended outcome, and keeps the full process in one evidence trail.

## Scale and measurement

Wexpro keeps approved credentials and sessions warm, re-authenticates when systems expire, and fans work out across thousands of parallel sessions. Production measurements include 99%+ agent completion, 25–30× lower cost than staff time measured from a real customer bill, and one live portal workflow optimizing from 12 minutes to 77 seconds.

## Illustrative workflow patterns

- Inbox request to an updated CRM record.
- Invoice or order to reconciled systems.
- Weekly exports to a checked client brief.
- Approved customer change to updated records.
- New client to ready onboarding systems.
- Recurring check to an exception queue.

Each pattern includes illustrative workload math so a buyer can see how volume, minutes per item, and the routine share translate into potential capacity. These are scenarios, not customer performance claims.

## Controlled pilot

Start with one recurring process the team already knows how to show. Map the workflow, review the draft, approve a limited replay, and compare the result with the current manual process before deciding whether to scale.
